messages.subject: Project Slate - term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Attached is our proposed term sheet for the Series C. Headline: Thornaby £42m of the £55m round, £210m pre / £265m post, 1x non-participating pref, broad-based weighted average anti-dilution, one board seat. 6-week exclusivity. Look forward to your thoughts.

Rohan

messages.subject: RE: Project Slate - term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Rohan,

Thanks. Broadly acceptable to the company. Two points: (1) option pool top-up to come out of the pre-money as agreed - we've reflected 10% post; (2) founder liability to be capped at a multiple of proceeds rather than the full round. Countersigned term sheet attached subject to those.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
